records.description: Splashd describes informal encounters at the park, but has no date-specific eyewitness or precise lawful area. records.name: Oxleas Wood
records.location: Oxleas Woods and Shooters Hill woodlands, Eltham/Greenwich, southeast London SE9.
records.description: Splashd labels a broad wooded area a cruising place. Royal Borough of Greenwich and Visit Greenwich verify the ancient Oxleas Woods as an SSSI nature reserve with public trails, but neither documents recent cruising. The archive's claimed subareas have no validated precise location.
records.original_source_description: Swath of accessible deciduous woodland within the Oxleas Wood recreation park, offering established cruising routes. Cruisiest at woods behind car park, or to the left of the outdoor gym. Walk to the area where the trees are marked with the word cock.
